title: Valid Parentheses
prompt:
Given a string containing only `()[]{}`, determine if it is valid: every opener closes with the matching bracket type, in the correct order.

**Example**: `"()[]{}"` → `true`; `"(]"` → `false`.

The matching-stack template with three bracket types.
hints: Push openers. On a closer, the stack top must be its matching opener.
A slick trick: when you see an opener, push its CLOSER — then a closer just needs `pop() == c`.
Two failure modes: closer with empty/wrong stack, and leftover openers (`return stack.isEmpty()`).

solution.explanation: Pushing the EXPECTED closer collapses the matching logic to one comparison. O(n)/O(n). "([)]" fails because the top expectation when `)` arrives is `]`.
